candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory calls timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating ReadTimeout through inventory and order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not admitted; whether the timeout is redis saturation vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory cascading to order and gateway checkout 502s; gateway p95 checkout latency ~2.4s matches the ~2s redis timeouts. Order metrics show postgres healthy, so the failure path is inventory->redis.
